a new role of a DEAD RNA helicase, SlDEAD39 from tomato, in plant development and response to salt stress.
the identification and characterization of a novel gene, RES, encoding a DEAD‐box helicase involved in plant development and response to salt‐stress.
the identification and characterization of the res gene, which encodes a chloroplast‐localized DEAD‐box RNA Helicase, and its role in tomato development and salt stress responses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DEAD‐box helicase SlDead39 is involved in chloroplast biogenesis, and its expression is regulated by salt stress.
the DEAD box protein SlDEAD39 has a role in plant development and in the response to salt stress, which is related to chloroplast function and the processing of the chloroplastic 23S rRNAs.
SlDEAD39 plays a crucial role in plant development and response to salt stress through its participation in the in vivo 23S rRNAs processing and the regulation of chloroplast and ribosome biogenesis.

a DEAD‐box protein is involved in the proper functioning of the chloroplast and the ribosome under salt‐stress.
the DEAD39 gene encodes a protein that is important for the development of tomato and that this protein is also important for the plant to respond to salinity stress.

a DEAD‐box helicase is involved in the processing of 23S r RNA, which is required to maintain the correct chloroplast functioning.
